scope: facts only; no probability, ranking, quote, trade, or ledger update

identity.question: Will 1 Fed rate cut happen in 2026?

literal_rule:
This market will resolve according to the exact amount of cuts of 25 basis points in 2026 by the Fed (including any cuts made during the December meeting).

Emergency rate cuts outside of scheduled FOMC meetings will also count toward the total number of cuts in 2026. This market will remain open until December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, to account for any such emergency actions.

For example, if the Fed cuts rates by 50 bps after a meeting, it would be considered 2 cuts (of 25 bps each).

This market will resolve early to "No" if the specified number of cuts becomes impossible — i.e., if more cuts have already occurred than the strike in question.

Note that cuts between 1–24 bps (inclusive) will also be considered 1 rate cut.

The resolution source for this market will be FOMC statements after meetings scheduled in 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm. The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

count_facts.basis: count 25bp cut units, not net change from start/end target
count_facts.timing: scheduled cuts incl Dec and emergency cuts outside scheduled meetings count
count_facts.early_no: if more cuts already occurred than the strike
count_facts.backdating: No backdated action identified in captured official history. Count dated actions; a later hike does not erase an earlier cut.

current_actuals.official_Fed_table_as_captured: The 2026 target-history table has one row through its Sep16 last update: Sep17, Increase 25bp, Decrease 0bp, range 3.75–4.00%. Thus documented 2026 decrease count by Oct21 is zero; this is a count from the Decrease column, not net-rate inference.

current_actuals.official_statement: Sep16 FOMC statement raised target by 25bp, effective Sep17, to 3.75–4.00%; upper bound 4.00%.
current_actuals.meeting_calendar: Official 2026 dates include Sep15–16 (past), Oct27–28 and Dec8–9 (both future as of Oct21). No Oct decision yet at fact cutoff.
current_actuals.latest_committee_view: Sep15–16 minutes (released Oct7): most participants judged another increase likely appropriate by year-end; future decisions open-minded and dependent on incoming info/outlook/risk balance. Not a decided action and not Dec-specific.
current_actuals.Waller_Oct8: Waller interpreted 16/18 September dot submissions as at least one more hike during two remaining meetings, four as two hikes; said hikes need not be consecutive. Individual interpretation of SEP, not FOMC decision or odds.
